take: Minnesota announced it activated defenseman Jared Spurgeon from injured reserve. In his 12 games this season, Spurgeon has averaged 20.24 minutes, and the Wild have controlled 65% of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality) with him on the ice at five-on-five, about 15 points better than without him. He has taken on a second-pair role of just over 18 minutes a night, with some penalty-kill time, and Matt Kiersted (12:22 a night) is next in line to give up minutes.
